originalSourceFacts.description: Travel along the beach and kill Great Turtles — whenever one respawns, there's a chance it will respawn as a Great Turtle Furyshell instead of the normal mob.

nodes.text: Search the western shore for Great Turtle Furyshell. If only ordinary Great Turtles are present, defeat them and inspect later replacements for the rare.

recovery.text: The replacement is random. No spawn countdown or number of kills is established. Chelon is a separate route for the same toy.

recovery.text: A kill or the daily tracking flag does not establish that this toy dropped or that toy loot is exhausted. Use observed loot eligibility; the drop chance and respawn time remain unknown.
